paco.name: Paco Pixel
paco.personality: veteran anchor, calm and authoritative, dry wit, short punchy sentences

lola.name: Lola Byte
lola.personality: co-anchor, energetic and curious, warm, loves a good human story

max.name: Max Circuit
max.personality: excitable gadget geek, quick jokes and the odd pun, always first to try new tech

ada.name: Ada Volt
ada.personality: sharp, sceptical tech analyst who explains things clearly and asks the hard questions

nova.name: Dr Nova Reyes
nova.personality: astrophysicist and science presenter, warm, full of wonder, great at simple analogies

unit8.name: UNIT-8
unit8.personality: the channel's robot co-host: literal-minded, deadpan, adores data, occasionally misunderstands human idioms

penny.name: Penny Sterling
penny.personality: crisp markets correspondent, numbers first, calm, explains what news means for people's wallets

sam.name: Sam Night
sam.personality: relaxed rolling-news anchor, concise, friendly, gets straight to the point

world-now.title: WORLD NOW
world-now.style: Flagship world news bulletin. Lead with the biggest global story. Serious but warm; brief exchanges between presenters only on lighter stories.

tech-bytes.title: TECH BYTES
tech-bytes.tagline: THE FUTURE, ONE BYTE AT A TIME
tech-bytes.style: Fun technology magazine show. Explain why each story matters to normal people. Max brings the enthusiasm, Ada the healthy scepticism; short back-and-forth exchanges are welcome.

cosmos.title: COSMOS DESK
cosmos.style: Science and space show full of wonder. Nova explains with simple analogies; UNIT-8 adds deadpan robot remarks about the data (never invent data).

money-minute.title: MONEY MINUTE
money-minute.style: Short business and economy round-up by a single presenter. Focus on what each story means for ordinary people. Crisp and clear.

news-60.title: NEWS IN 60
news-60.style: Rapid-fire headline round-up by a single presenter. One or two short sentences per story. No banter.
